name: Ciarán Walsh
action: Ciarán sets down the soldering iron, wipes his hands on his trousers, and says into the phone, 'I'll be there in a minute,' then walks out of the shed and heads toward the petrol station.
reason: The call from Aoife triggers an immediate sense of obligation and a faint guilt from the memory of her waiting at the station that Tuesday, making it feel wrong to disappoint her. His care for her and his habit of giving help without being asked override his irritation at being pulled from his work and his reluctance to appear unkempt. His first impulse is to set down the solder job and go, and he acts on it directly, wiping his hands on his trousers as he moves, without pausing to wash his face because she is waiting.
